name: hello
what: startup, print, exit: the size floor (#6328), and the gauntlet cli.hello cell

name: collatz
what: integer loop with data-dependent branches

name: fib
what: calls: naive doubly recursive Fibonacci

name: isum
what: list fill and bounds-checked index reads

name: memcopy
what: the memory kernel's byte copy and move (mem.copy<U8>), 1 byte to 16 KiB, overlapping either way

name: memfill
what: the memory kernel's byte fill (mem.fill<U8>), 1 byte to 16 KiB at any alignment

name: rawword
what: the memory kernel's raw word access: a pointer's offset, its read through `.*` and its write through mem.volatile_write

name: atomics
what: the memory kernel's atomic word: an Atomic<I64>'s add, load, compare_exchange and store

name: mapping
what: the memory kernel's page mapping: mem.Region.reserve of 64 KiB and the region's close

name: compare
what: the memory kernel's byte compare: the safe equality of two [U8], 1 byte to 16 KiB

name: allocfree
what: the memory kernel's heap: mem.alloc_raw and mem.free_raw of 1 byte to 1 KiB over 256 slots

name: resize
what: the memory kernel's resize: mem.list_append of 1 to 64 bytes over 256 byte lists, grown in place or moved

name: sieve
what: the gauntlet numerics.int-kernel cell

name: wordfreq
what: the gauntlet text.kernel cell: whitespace split, exact token counts, top 20

name: nbody
what: the gauntlet numerics.float-kernel cell: five bodies, symplectic Euler, energy before and after

name: bulkrename
what: the gauntlet files.script cell: list a directory, rename the IMG_<n>.jpeg files in number order

name: taskfile
what: the gauntlet cli.app and formats.json-app cells: a JSON task store, one process per add/done/list step

name: tensormap
what: the gauntlet numerics.tensor-map cell: two 4096 x 4096 double tensors, their sum, its corner and checksum

name: fft
what: the gauntlet numerics.fft cell: the 4096-point transform of an impulse, checked to 1e-9

name: binparse
what: the gauntlet formats.binary-kernel cell: 300000 little-endian records, a sum over every seventh id and FNV-1a over the names

name: regexlogscan
what: the gauntlet text.regex-kernel cell: 500000 combined-log rows, those with a 5xx status and an /api/ path counted per client, top 5

name: regexfindall
what: the gauntlet text.regex-find-all-large cell: non-overlapping matches of the literal regex `struct` in a 4 MiB corpus

name: sensorring
what: the gauntlet embedded.kernel cell: 12000 ticks of a sensor-ring firmware core (ADC sample, CRC-16 frame, 16-slot ring, fixed-point controller, MMIO trace checksums)

name: csvtransform
what: the gauntlet formats.csv-cli cell: 200000 RFC-4180 sales rows, the positive amounts counted and summed per region

name: logreport
what: the gauntlet text.report-cli cell: an application log's lines, RFC 3339 stamps parsed, levels counted, the 3 components with the most ERROR lines ranked, first and last stamps and the span printed

name: embeddeddata
what: the gauntlet embedded.data cell: an EDB1 telemetry file of 1000000 12-byte frames, every byte summed, the valid frames counted per channel with sample, energy, load and tick aggregates

name: w11fetch
what: ScriptBench w11: fetch http://127.0.0.1:18411/item/<i> for 100 ids, at most 32 at a time, from the fixture server that answers after 20 ms, and count the 200s with a nonempty body

name: textscript
what: the gauntlet text.script cell: a notes file's lines trimmed, the blank ones dropped, the rest sorted and printed after their count

name: datasummary
what: the gauntlet numerics.script and numerics.notebook cells: 50000 CSV measurements grouped, each group's count, mean, lower median, p95 and population sd to two decimals, then the overall count and mean

name: tzreport
what: the gauntlet time.script and time.notebook cells: RFC 3339 meetings with offsets put in UTC, ordered by instant, each with its weekday and the minutes since the one before, then the span and count

name: gameframe
what: the gauntlet games.frame cell: 1200 frames of a 320x200 premultiplied RGBA8 scene (clear, opaque tiles, translucent sprites and HUD bar, 5x7 bitmap text) and their counts

name: procpipe
what: the gauntlet files.orchestration cell: four child processes (a captured python3, python3 piped into sort, a python3 sleep killed after 300ms, a python3 exit 3) and one transcript line each

name: parallelgrep
what: the gauntlet concurrency.app cell: 200000 .txt files in 200 directories walked, each read and its needle occurrences counted, the matching paths sorted, then matched/scanned and the total

name: httpclient
what: the gauntlet netserv.client cell: four HTTP GETs of a JSON item service (the listing, two items and a 404), decoded and printed with the listing's count and total quantity

name: concurrencyservice
what: the gauntlet concurrency.service cell: a line TCP service whose batch command fans 1..N out to four workers (1ms of work each) and answers their squares' sum; measured by the gauntlet's service replay

name: httpservice
what: the gauntlet netserv.service cell: a JSON key-value HTTP/1.1 service (GET /health, PUT and GET /kv/<key>, GET /shutdown); measured by the gauntlet's service replay
